documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: TCPL Packaging reported a strong Q2 FY27 performance, crossing INR 500 crore in quarterly total income and INR 100 crore in quarterly EBITDA for the first time. The company's growth was supported by healthy customer demand in the domestic market, deeper customer relationships, and improving operational efficiencies. Management incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, TCPL Energy Materials Limited, to enter the lithium-ion battery separator films business through a phased investment approach. While navigating elevated raw material and logistics costs, the company remains positive about ongoing growth opportunities across paperboard and flexible packaging. TCPL Packaging reported strong financial performance for Q2 FY2027, with consolidated total income growing 20% year-on-year to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets commercial production for the battery separator film project during Q4 FY28.
guidance.quote: commercial production targeted during Q4 FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see healthy momentum across paperboard and flexible packaging.
demand_outlook.quote: Moving to our business performance. We continue to see healthy momentum across paperboard and flexible packaging.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business has sustained double-digit growth supported by customer demand and deeper relationships.
demand_outlook.quote: Our domestic business has sustained double-digit growth, supported by healthy customer demand and deeper relationships with existing customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains cautious on the near-term export outlook due to ongoing global uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: Our export business also recorded steady year-on-year growth; however, we remain cautious on the near-term outlook given the continuing uncertainty in the global operating environment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to start with a coating process and later backward integrate into extrusion.
capex_expansion.quote: Like we explained in our initial presentation, we will be starting with the coating process. So these are water-based coating machines. Then we will backward integrate into extrusion, which is a much bigger investment and much bigger line.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated a new subsidiary to manufacture lithium-ion battery separator films.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, we have incorporated TCPL Energy Materials Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, to undertake our lithium-ion battery separator films business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently in the initial stages of establishing manufacturing infrastructure for the battery separator films project.
capex_expansion.quote: We are making progress in the initial stages of the project, with a focus on establishing the necessary manufacturing infrastructure and building the capabilities required for this venture.

capex_expansion.claim: To support growth in the Flexible Packaging business, the company initiated the addition of a high speed manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: To support the next phase of growth, we have initiated the addition of a high speed manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The lithium-ion battery separator film project will be established through a subsidiary with a proposed investment of approximately INR 125 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The project will be established through a subsidiary with a proposed investment of approximately INR 125 crore, to be deployed over the next 18 months, with commercial production targeted during Q4 FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: The flexible packaging capacity will increase by about 30% with an investment of about INR 50 crore to INR 60 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: We will be adding about a 30% increase to our existing capacity. You can say that the capacity will increase by about 30%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 grew by 20.2% year-on-year to INR 564.6 crore.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 564.6 crore, registering a growth of 20.2% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 27.5% to INR 100.1 crore, with margins improving by approximately 100 basis points to 17.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA, including other income, increased by 27.5% to INR 100.1 crore, with margins improving by approximately 100 basis points to 17.7%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT increased by 57.7% to INR 45.3 crore in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT increased by 57.7% to INR 45.3 crore, while cash profit grew 44.2% to INR 84.9 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The operating environment continues to be impacted by elevated raw material and logistics costs.
margins_costs.quote: The improvement in profitability is particularly encouraging given the operating environment, which continues to be impacted by elevated raw material and logistics costs.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income increased by 16% year-on-year to INR 495 crore, while EBITDA grew by 17% to INR 88 crore with margins improving to 18%.
margins_costs.quote: During the first quarter, we delivered a record quarterly performance, with consolidated total income increasing by 16% year-on-year to INR 495 crore, while EBITDA grew by 17% to INR 88 crore with margins improving to 18%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Chennai facility is steadily improving utilization and management hopes to add another line next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as Chennai is concerned, that is also steadily improving utilization. Hopefully, sometime next year, we can add another line.

orders_capacity.claim: The existing flexible packaging facility is operating at optimal utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing facility is now operating at optimal utilization, supported by strong customer demand.

capital_allocation.claim: Packaging remains the cornerstone of TCPL and will continue to be the principal focus of investments.
capital_allocation.quote: Packaging remains the cornerstone of TCPL and will continue to be the principal focus of our investments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export performance has been affected by a challenging geopolitical environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Export performance has also been satisfactory, especially keeping in mind the challenging geopolitical environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Noida subsidiary experienced disappointing growth due to high memory chip prices and export-oriented business not panning out.
risks_headwinds.quote: But basically, our Noida subsidiary this year, the growth has been disappointing and below expectation largely due to two factors. Number one is there has been a huge run-up in memory chip prices, which has contributed to smartphone prices going up a lot, and that has depressed the volumes you may have seen that India is producing a decade low in the quantity of mobile phones. And then the second thing is there were some good projections or indications for business which was ultimately export-oriented, which did not pan out the way we expected considering the war and geopolitical disruption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted continuing uncertainty in the global operating environment affecting the near-term export outlook.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our export business also recorded steady year-on-year growth; however, we remain cautious on the near-term outlook given the continuing uncertainty in the global operating environment.

management_commitments.claim: The company's endeavour is to sustain its historical revenue growth trajectory while enhancing cash generation.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, our endeavour is to sustain our historical revenue growth trajectory while enhancing cash generation and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The battery separator film project investment of approximately INR 125 crore is to be deployed over the next 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: The project will be established through a subsidiary with a proposed investment of approximately INR 125 crore, to be deployed over the next 18 months, with commercial production targeted during Q4 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commercialization of Phase 1 for the new business is targeted by Q4 FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our target is to commercialize by Q4 FY28. So January or February 2028 is our target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
